blurb: Dual Citizen Brewing Company brews a variety of craft beers including Hazy IPA, West Coast IPA, Lager, Hazy Pale Ale, and Sour Ale. The taproom hosts events such as book store pop-ups, euchre tournaments, music nights, salsa dancing lessons, and seasonal markets. They focus on community engagement and supporting local causes.
